title: X: The Leech and His Patient

teacherSummary.text: Chillingworth digs ever deeper into Dimmesdale's mind. Over black weeds from an unmarked grave they argue about why some men never confess. Pearl, in the graveyard, throws a burr at the minister and calls the physician the Black Man. Later Chillingworth opens the sleeping minister's vestment, sees something on his breast, and reacts with wild joy.
